name: Itsuka no Kaze ga Fuku Basho e
original_name: いつかの風が吹く場所へ
source:
"What do I want to achieve from running, anyway..."
Said Toono Hayato, who was also running in the early morning's city today.

He continued to run without any goal or meaning as if to shake off his old self, or to escape from the present days when nothing was happening.

"Why don't we find it together? The joy of running."

One morning, Hayato meets Hoshikawa Hikari, a talented girl who has given up her dream...
What is the goal lying behind the bright road where the two who have lost their dreams, Hayato and the innocent Hikari, start running together?

This is the beginning of their clumsy youthful drama.

[Translated from the [url=http://team-oretachi.ivory.ne.jp/itsukaze/story.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
“无论如何，我想通过跑步获得什么……”
今天同样在凌晨城市跑步的远野隼人说道。

他继续奔跑，没有任何目标和意义，似乎是为了摆脱过去的自己，或者是为了逃避现在什么都没有发生的日子。

“我们为什么不一起寻找跑步的乐趣呢。”

一天早上，隼人遇见了放弃梦想的天才少女星川光……
隼人与天真无邪的光这两个失去梦想的人一起奔跑的光明之路，背后的目标是什么？

这是他们笨拙的青春剧的开始。

[翻译自[url=http://team-oretachi.ivory.ne.jp/itsukaze/story.html]官方网站[/url]]
